_doc: Rules of the upgrade trees (GDD 4.8; docs/contratos/h5_mejoras.md). The upgrades themselves: data/upgrades/<tree>/<id>.json (one file each). branches: the 8 branches in UI order; levels: levels per branch. effect_kinds: every effect type an upgrade may declare (the validator refuses others). value: the field the effect carries (mult = multiplier, amount = number added, zone / recipe / rank = an id, flag = nothing). stack: branch_top = in each branch only the highest owned level that has this kind counts (the levels of a branch replace each other: speed x1.2 -> x1.4 -> x1.6), then branches combine; all = every owned upgrade counts. when: query = other systems ask Upgrades.mult / amount / unlocks / flag every time; complete = applied once to the stored state when the works end (Upgrades.complete). reader: the system that reads it (who integrates it: the contract).

effect_kinds._farm_doc: H12 Patrón (04d 4.22.7): field_yield multiplies a harvest (Fields.harvest_of), pen_capacity adds heads to the pen (Herds.capacity), market_price multiplies what the family gets at the market for the farm's goods (its crops' yield, its animals and what they produce; Fields.sale_mult): the farm's Commerce branch, which has no counter to sell from.

_titles_doc: GDD 4.12.2, lowest first. A family without a title field (until H9) is default_title. requires.title of an upgrade = the minimum title of the owner family.
_inspections_doc: GDD 4.8 (Secrets branch): every dawn, each building with inspection_risk > 0 rolls p = sum(inspection_risk) x (1 - honesty / honesty_divisor) with state.rng. Caught: a fine (fine [min, max], whole gold, state.rng; category fines) and reputation (GDD 4.12.1: condena con multa -10). The automatic trial of 4.12 comes with H11 ('multa por ahora', 10). escape_cooldown_days: the hidden passage (inspection_escape) avoids one inspection that caught you, then needs this many days to be usable again [provisional: the GDD says 'escapar de una inspección'].
_fine_loan_doc: Pulido del MVP [provisional]: a fine (inspection, court) is paid from the gold above keep_gold (what the family needs to keep working: buying iron); the rest becomes a debt with the town (a Loan like the start debt, GDD 4.16: due in term_days, warnings, extension with surcharge, seizure and ruin), added to the open one if there is. Before, the fine took every coin and its debt swallowed every income: a forge with no stock was stuck forever.

works._doc: Equilibrio 9 (docs/decisiones.json, GDD 4.8) [balance]: how a works goes. An upgrade with build_days <= small_max_days is small (small_mode night: built during the coming night, done at the next dawn; the building keeps working). A bigger one (big_mode half) leaves the building working: the cycles that start during it take 1 / big_speed as long. closed (the old rule: nobody works there) is only for a save from before.
